items.markdown:
Finding the right chair for an 8-plus hour workday comes down to adjustability, build quality, and how your body likes to be supported. Top-rated options span a wide range of budgets and sitting styles:

### Top Picks for Long Hours

- **Best Overall for Reclining & Movement: [Herman Miller Embody](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462732890363511,imageDocid:8429944052168884251,gpcid:16162280338043236049,headlineOfferDocid:6697031873355848002,catalogid:15895430170558959163,productDocid:8224994342968456063,rds:PC_18140897429589984861%7CPROD_PC_18140897429589984861&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj2-dCJ34KYAxVNX0EAHe-ZLW8Qxa4PeggIAggBCBAQAw)** *(~ $2,395)* 
	- *Why it rocks:* Designed with a "pixelated support" matrix that flexes with your micro-movements and spine in real-time. It shines brightest for people who like a slight or active recline while working. Comes with a 12-year warranty.[[1]](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-office-chairs/)
- **The Gold Standard Mesh Chair: [Herman Miller Aeron](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462492398406605,imageDocid:12930407149724119953,gpcid:13007852262511206390,headlineOfferDocid:13316549878881847801,catalogid:12554393588505164957,productDocid:17708865242281143555,rds:PC_13007852262511206390%7CPROD_PC_13007852262511206390&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj2-dCJ34KYAxVNX0EAHe-ZLW8Qxa4PeggIAggBCBAQCw)** *(~ $2,250)* 
	- *Why it rocks:* Iconic breathability, iconic posture-fit sacral/lumbar support (PostureFit SL), and different sizing options (Size A, B, C) to fit your exact frame. Unmatched long-term commercial durability.[[1]](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-office-chairs/)
- **Best All-Day Comfort Runner-Up: [Steelcase Gesture](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462576110688477,imageDocid:14470985122277100104,gpcid:13295908629286786165,headlineOfferDocid:4529591770917489357,catalogid:15688447677928822158,productDocid:13442170855201784889,rds:PC_13295908629286786165%7CPROD_PC_13295908629286786165&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj2-dCJ34KYAxVNX0EAHe-ZLW8Qxa4PeggIAggBCBAQEw)** *(~ $1,208)* 
	- *Why it rocks:* Engineered explicitly to move with you as you shift positions, use a phone, type, or lean back. Its 360-degree arms move wherever your arms go.[[1]](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-office-chairs/)
- **Best Mid-Range Value: [Branch Ergonomic Chair](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462704272406801,imageDocid:5528060348129638683,gpcid:13142538113547815565,headlineOfferDocid:10185077111669560349,catalogid:13800606237824248452,productDocid:9040866115576321337,rds:PC_13142538113547815565%7CPROD_PC_13142538113547815565&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj2-dCJ34KYAxVNX0EAHe-ZLW8Qxa4PeggIAggBCBAQGw)** *(~ $311)* 
	- *Why it rocks:* Built for a solid 8-hour shift featuring 8 individual adjustment points, a supportive dual-layer cushion, and a breathable mesh back without breaking the bank.[[1]](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-office-chairs/)
- **Best Budget Pick: [Staples Dexley Mesh Chair](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462829373862491,imageDocid:15800475976579756180,gpcid:494170256274311933,headlineOfferDocid:3903576819120034759,catalogid:13914021081082649659,productDocid:10513286823174451257,rds:PC_494170256274311933%7CPROD_PC_494170256274311933&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj2-dCJ34KYAxVNX0EAHe-ZLW8Qxa4PeggIAggBCBAQIw)** *(~ $120)* 
	- *Why it rocks:* A great entry-level mesh back chair with tilt-lock and adjustable head support if you need good daily ergonomics on a strict budget.[[1]](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-office-chairs/)

### Quick Comparison Guide

To help narrow this down, let me know:

- What is your **approximate budget**?
- Do you prefer a **mesh back** or a **upholstered/cushioned back**?
- Do you tend to sit **strictly upright** or do you like to **recline** while working?
